deduplication: Before accepting PCM compare full original hash and source identity against previously used sources, B11 primary and replication reservations, and the other B12 panel. No replay as a new original.
entry: Open only after B11 reaches terminal acoustic nonpromotion and B12 training is authorized. B11 success leaves both B12 proposals unused.
rate_qualification: A verified faster original must use faster native renderer parameters and have fewer samples than its matched same-text, same-voice slow original. Apply the gate to verified faster true positives only.
replication: Open only after a preregistered B12 primary pass with all conditions in the frozen tempo recipe. Compare identically fixed B0, B9, B12-A and B12-B without retuning.
source_qualification: Freeze five independent native observations before any KWS forward; Silver/Weak positives or ordinary only, all UNKNOWN excluded. Require at least four independently qualified paired groups with both classes. A group is a statistical unit.
training: Original authorized TRAIN exclusively. Primary/replication DEV and CAL/LOCKED contribute no gradients.
